name: Dynamic Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm, elbow under your shoulder, legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Lower your hips toward the floor a few inches under control.
Raise your hips back to the straight line.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A side plank with hip raises and dips that trains the obliques and hip stabilisers.
